<html><head>
<meta charset="utf-8"/>
<meta content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, minimum-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=2.0" name="viewport"/>
<title>CIGAR.com</title>
<style>
        body {
            text-align: center;
            margin: 0 auto;
            padding-top: 120px;
            width: 100%;
            background-color: white;
            font-size: 18px;
            font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
        
        }

        img {
            margin: 40px 0;

        }

        #main {
            width: 80%;
            min-width: 200px;
            min-height: 300px;
            max-height: 500px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            border: solid 17px #eeeeee;
            box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #57575a inset;
            background-color: #eeeeee;
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 20px;
            overflow-x: hidden;
            overflow-y: auto;
        }

        /* media queries*/

        @media screen and ( max-width: 320px) {

            body { width: 80%; margin: 50px 18px; padding-top: 50px; }
            #main { margin: 0 auto; }
            img { width: 80%; }
        }
        @media screen and (min-width: 321px) and ( max-width: 360px) { 

            body {  width: 90%; margin: 50px 13px; padding-top: 50px; }
            #main { margin: 0 auto; }
            img { width: 80%; }
        }
      
        @media screen and (min-width: 360px) and ( max-width: 375px) {

            body {  width: 90%; margin: 50px 13px; padding-top: 50px; }
            #main { margin: 0 auto; }
            img { width: 80%; }

          
        }
        @media screen and (min-width: 375px) and ( max-width: 500px) {

            body { width: 90%; margin: 50px 20px; padding-top: 50px; }
            #main { margin: 0 auto; }
            img { width: 80%;}
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="main">
<img src="data:image/png;base64,"/>
<p>Due to GDPR regulations, our website is currently unavailable in EU member countries.</p>
<p>If you've received this message in error, please contact us at <strong>800.357.9800</strong>.</p>
</div>
</body></html>
